The Industrial Revolution drew people to cities, creating wealth and jobs but also child labor and polluted slums.

The central idea is that it:
A) had only benefits
B) transformed society with both benefits and serious costs
C) had no effect

solution.answer: B) transformed society with both benefits and serious costs

items.prompt:
Read.

Vaccines train the immune system using a harmless germ piece.

How do they work?
A) by making you sick for good
B) by training the immune system with a harmless germ piece
C) by killing all viruses forever
items.answer: B) by training the immune system with a harmless germ piece

solution.answer: B) by training the immune system with a harmless germ piece

items.prompt:
Read.

The printing press made books cheaper and spread literacy.

An effect was:
A) fewer readers
B) more literacy
C) no change

Read.

Coral reefs cover under 1% of the ocean floor, yet support about a quarter of all marine species. As seas warm, many reefs are dying.

Which is BEST supported?
A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life
B) Reefs are unimportant
C) All marine life lives on land
items.answer: A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life

solution.answer: A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life

items.prompt:
Read.

The author warns that overfishing could collapse fish stocks and urges stricter limits.

The author's point of view is BEST described as:
A) in favor of unlimited fishing
B) concerned about overfishing and for stricter limits
C) neutral
items.answer: B) concerned about overfishing and for stricter limits

steps: Warning + urging = a stance. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) concerned about overfishing and for stricter limits
